# South Florida Cleaning Concepts

> South Florida Cleaning Concepts is a premier commercial janitorial, specialized medical facility disinfection, short-term rental turnover, post-construction cleanup, and luxury residential cleaning service provider operating across 56 communities in Palm Beach, Broward, Miami-Dade, and neighboring Florida counties from Jupiter south to Miami.

## Service Divisions

- [Commercial Office Cleaning](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/office-cleaning): Keep your workplace spotless across Palm Beach, Broward, and Miami-Dade without disrupting daily operations. Our reliable evening, daytime, or weekend crews sanitize desks, breakrooms, lobbies, and restrooms so your team walks into a fresh office every morning.
- [Medical Office & Healthcare Disinfection](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/medical-office-cleaning): Patients judge clinical care the moment they enter your lobby. Our trained healthcare specialists use hospital-grade disinfectants and color-coded cloths for every zone—keeping waiting rooms, dental chairs, exam suites, and staff areas sanitary and inspection-ready across South Florida.
- [Short-Term Rental & Vacation Rental Turnover](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/short-term-rentals): One stray hair can cost a 5-star review. We put South Florida Airbnb and VRBO turnovers on autopilot between 10 AM check-out and 4 PM check-in—laundering linens, detailing kitchens and baths, restocking essentials, and texting completion photos.
- [Luxury Residential & Home Maintenance (4-Step Rotation System)](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/home-maintenance): Reclaim your weekends across Palm Beach, Broward, and Miami-Dade. Our recurring service uses our 4-Step Rotation System and kid- and pet-safe products to handle South Florida humidity, sand, and dust—plus optional pressure washing, window cleaning, and gutter maintenance upon request.
- [Post-Construction Cleanup](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/post-construction-cleaning): Turn dusty renovations and new builds into polished showplaces. Our post-construction crew clears fine drywall dust, removes window stickers and paint splatters, details every cabinet inside and out, and protects delicate stone, glass, and hardwood finishes.
- [Commercial Bar & Restaurant Cleaning](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/bars-and-restaurant-cleaning): Our overnight restaurant teams step in after last call so you open ready for lunch service. We cut through tough cookline grease, sanitize bar wells and draft taps, and leave dining booths, entry glass, and guest restrooms sparkling before staff arrive.
- [School & Daycare Cleaning Services](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/school-cleaning): Little hands touch everything in classrooms and daycares. We partner with South Florida preschools, academies, and learning centers to sanitize desks, cubbies, play mats, cafeterias, and restrooms daily using non-toxic, fume-free disinfectants safe around children.
- [Move In / Move Out Cleaning Services](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/move-in-out-cleaning): Leave the final scrub to us while you handle boxes and movers. Whether securing a renter’s security deposit, prepping a South Florida listing for photos, or sanitizing a newly purchased home, we deep-clean every empty room from ceiling fans to baseboards.
- [Professional Home Watching Services](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/home-watching): Protect your vacant South Florida home while traveling or away for the season. One clogged AC line or tripped breaker can spoil a refrigerator or cause costly moisture damage. Our specialists inspect interiors and exteriors, monitor AC, humidity, and refrigerators/freezers, and send timestamped photo reports.
- [COVID-19 Disinfection & Electrostatic Spraying](https://sfcleaningconcepts.com/service/covid-19-disinfection): Protect your home or workplace after illness or during peak flu season. Our electrostatic spraying wraps hospital-grade, EPA-approved disinfectant around desks, upholstery, doorknobs, and hard-to-reach corners—neutralizing 99.99% of viruses and bacteria safely with minimal downtime.

## Company Credentials & Standards

- **Licensing & Insurance**: Fully licensed, insured, and bonded residential and commercial cleaning specialists (South Florida Cleaning Concepts LLC).
- **Love Your Clean or Don’t Pay Guarantee**: Not 100% thrilled? Let us know within 24 hours and we’ll re-clean for free—or you don’t pay.
- **Local Reputation**: Rated 4.8 stars (100+ Verified Local Reviews) with over 20 years of family-owned care since 2004.
- **Online Booking Offer**: 12% Off When Booking From Our Website — Save 12% on your first clean when you book directly through our website.
- **Eco-Safe & Color-Coded Supplies**: EPA-registered hospital-grade disinfectants, eco-friendly products safe for kids and pets, and strict color-coded microfiber isolation.
- **Vetted Personnel & Careers**: Background-checked, supervisor-trained local crews. We Are Hiring! Join our vetted South Florida team—competitive pay, paid training, and flexible local schedules.
